# New feature: "Best Build" for CAMP Builder (Best Builds)

![New Feature: `Best Build` for CAMP Builder (Best Builds)](/uploads/389_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

"**Best Builds**" (or now called "Bester Build" in German) is a new feature that was introduced in the Milepost Zero Update on September 3rd, 2024. It is primarily aimed at the enthusiastic **CAMP builders** who can use it to better present their camps. This even allows other players to leave **Likes** for your camp.

Camps submitted as Best Build appear on random worlds in **hourly rotation**. So the builder of the CAMP cannot be on the same world. Best Builds are essentially ghost camps. This also means that vending machines do not work in this context. And you may also have problems setting up your camp if it is blocked by a best build. I hope these things will be resolved upon release.

However, the name "Best Builds" is a bit unfortunate, as it will probably be difficult for anyone interested in Fallout 76 players to research the topic. Under this term you can find a lot of builds, but (like us) they are skills sets and explain how to play with a character. These search results are also mainly found on YouTube. But now to the details.

![Best Builds](/uploads/nukaknights-post-bestbuilds-20240711214859-1.jpg)

## Detect best builds on the map

The Best Builds are clearly highlighted on the map and highlighted in blue. The name of the build is displayed here as the camp owner defines it using keywords. You can only see the name of the camp owner when you click on it.

In addition to the player name, the preview now shows various information about the topic of the build, the number of likes so far and preview images. Before you visit the camp, you can take a look at some pictures of it.

Fast travel to the Best Build Camp costs the same as usual and depends on the distance and the perks. Nothing has changed there.

![Best Build](/uploads/nukaknights-post-bestbuilds-20240712092118-1-map.jpg)

![Best Builds Preview](/uploads/nukaknights-post-bestbuilds-20240712092123-1-preview.jpg)

## Like Best Builds

If you like a Best Build, you can give it a like. However, this is only possible if you are in the respective area. A remote like based on the preview is not possible.

So you now travel or walk to the best build to take a closer look at it. 

As soon as you enter the camp area, you will see a "Reputation" overlay on the right that you can activate if you want. This will take you to the preview where you can leave a like. You can also access this preview via the map (in case you missed the overlay).

![Best Builds Like](/uploads/nukaknights-post-bestbuilds-20240712092239-1-like.jpg)

## Submit Best Builds

If you would like to submit your CAMP as a Best Build, you can simply do so while you are in your CAMP. To do this, click on your CAMP and on the new menu item “Manage Best Build” (translation not yet determined).

![Manage Best Build](/uploads/nukaknights-post-bestbuilds-20240711223501-1-manage.jpg)

Now you will see the Best Build interface with the selection of your keywords and the upload of your images. You have a huge selection of keywords. Because it's quite difficult to find something suitable. Once you have decided on 3 suitable keywords, you can now take pictures using the photo mode. To do this, click on a + and take a suitable picture.
